header_verifier.source_verification_boundary: Only last-bottom/first-top adjacent native candidate pages receive independent inference. Unique same-physical-page geometry match, whole header text/anchor/span agreement on both ends, observed source-cell-supported boundaries, title/unit/native typed furniture and complete native body context are required. Transfers header-role/geometry/scope metadata only; rejects preserve every native value and header. Per-edge allowlist prevents permission leakage. Docling-only footer roles never hide native business text. All single tables emit table-source. Whole-document native typed furniture provides hierarchical pagination evidence even on pages without tables.

HTML_span_adapter.algorithm: Preflight explicit source cells using one exclusive span-end row per column; verify full projected rows/columns/product and overlap before allocating output matrix. HTML_span_adapter.invalid_or_over_budget_behavior: Not implemented in this minimal v2; truly invalid or over-budget native tables retain existing ParserError behavior. No claim to have solved that broader issue.
